response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced generalist engineer (15+ years, staff-level titles, strong TypeScript/Node, distributed systems, high-throughput data integration, and a track record of teaching and mentoring) with recent, directly relevant exposure to MCP servers and agentic developer tooling at re:cinq. However, the resume shows roughly one year of AI-adjacent work versus the required 8+ years shipping production AI solutions, and it lacks explicit evidence of Python, vector databases, RAG architectures, LLM evaluation/observability, or multi-agent frameworks. Cloud depth is limited to AWS CDK usage rather than designing AI systems on major cloud platforms. He could be a strong candidate for a senior full-stack or platform role, or a Staff FDE role where AI depth can be grown, but on the stated GenAI bar he is under-qualified. A screening call would be worthwhile to probe the depth of the re:cinq agentic work, which is under-described.
strengths: 15+ years shipping production software; staff-level scope and polyglot breadth
Hands-on MCP server / agentic tooling work plus strong TypeScript, Node, Docker, Kubernetes
Proven mentoring and technical-leadership signal via workshops, courses, talks, and consulting work
concerns: Only ~1 year of AI-specific work vs. 8+ years of production AI required
No evidence of Python, vector databases, RAG, LLM evaluation, or multi-agent frameworks
Limited cloud architecture depth and no clear enterprise customer-facing discovery/delivery experience

key_factors.factor: Depth of general engineering and staff-level delivery
Recent MCP and agentic infrastructure work
